name: Acoustic Duo and Trio
spec: Voice and guitar, guitar and upright bass, or all three
alt: Acoustic and electric guitars, a keyboard and a microphone stand by tall windows.
blurb: An acoustic duo plays the songs your guests already know, with voice and guitar or guitar and upright bass, and it can stay soft enough for everyone to keep talking. You can book it for just an hour or from the time guests arrive through dinner, and if you'd like a fuller sound, a third musician makes it a trio.
